name: Web Agent
job: your HTML becomes a WordPress draft page, checked
cadence: When Katherine uploads a page on the Web page (the Box picks it up within 15 minutes)
card_only: works on its own page, Web: upload a page there

sources.label: the page Katherine uploads on the Web page, with its cleared photos

does: Turns the HTML page Katherine uploads into a NEW DRAFT page on that WordPress site, with her cleared photos in the Media Library
Reads the draft back and proves it is the only page on the site that changed
Runs the page checks (photos cleared, links, wording, the AI-tells list) and puts one card on the Review tab with the results

traits.cant: Publish a page or change the live page
traits.instead: Saves a draft and links it; Katherine copies it over in WordPress herself while publishing is switched off

traits.cant: Use a photo that is not cleared
traits.instead: Names the photo on the card and leaves it out
